notes.title: Online Co-Op Experimental Beta!
notes.content:
[h1][b]DISCLAIMER!![/b] This is just a fun experiment for now. It's not fully-featured and it might not be great. Depending on my job / personal life, it may not get worked on quickly, or at all.

[b]TLDR don't buy Bleed 2 for this beta!!![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939630/6c356d900a3ab6b7f40b11f8d30e0e96ae9a74f0.png[/img]

...is anyone still reading? Well, in my spare time, I've been working on online co-op for Bleed 2! I'm making it a public (PC-only) Steam Beta in case anyone wants to try (I'd love to hear how it goes!)

[h1]Here's what's included:[/h1]
-Play Arcade or Endless mode in online co-op
-Supports all characters
-For Arcade: supports leaderboards and replays, in both NG and Freestyle
-For Endless: supports both Random and Seeded runs

[h1]To access the beta:[/h1]
-Right-click Bleed 2 in your Steam Library and select 'Properties'
-Click the 'Betas' tab and select the 'netplay-beta'!

Tadaa! Now there'll be an ONLINE option on the main menu. Create a game and invite a friend who is also in the beta and you should be off!

Finally, if you're looking for someone to play with, you can always ask around the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/CS2hZkM]Bleed community Discord![/url]

If you try it I hope you have fun, and that it isn't a total trainwreck!
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Endless Mode Update!
notes.content:
Hey folks! To celebrate Bleed 2's one-year anniversary, I've updated the game with the all-new Endless Mode!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939630/6c356d900a3ab6b7f40b11f8d30e0e96ae9a74f0.png[/img]

Endless Mode brings randomly-generated levels to Bleed 2! It mashes-up elements from both Bleed games and remixes them into an unpredictable, ever-changing set of new challenges! Just select 'Endless' from the 'Play' menu and you'll be off.

It also includes daily challenges. Take on a new set of levels every day, then check the leaderboards to see how you stack up against the rest of the world! You can even watch replays of the runs to see how people got their scores.

Daily challenges get harder throughout the week, so you can enjoy a nice Normal run today (Monday), but eventually you'll get to Saturday's Too Hard challenge... good luck! Most dailies let you pick your own character and weapons, though some make everyone play with specific characters.

Finally, this is all available for solo and local co-op.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939630/d0d1422ba6434c555083a81299886f68fd89d4d2.png[/img]

Thanks for playing Bleed 2! I hope this update lets you enjoy the game for a long time to come. See you on the leaderboards!

-Ian
